# Digitally Kolkata

> High-Impact Digital Marketing, Brand Strategy & High-Velocity Web Engineering in Kolkata, West Bengal.

Founded on the principle that "Local Brands Deserve Global Reach", Digitally Kolkata merges software engineering precision, technical SEO rigor, and behavior-driven visual storytelling to scale businesses across India and international markets.

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. [Brand Identity & Strategy](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#services) (Base: ₹15,000 INR)
   - Visual identity systems, logo design, typography guidelines, mascot adaptations, and brand positioning.
   - Proven impact across retail, FMCG, and hospitality.

2. [Custom Web Development](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#services) (Base: ₹28,000 INR)
   - High-performance, clean-code web applications built without bloated CMS plugins.
   - Sub-second load times (<1.0s), 100/100 Lighthouse performance, mobile-first responsive architecture.
   - Global CDN edge deployment on Vercel with automated SSL.

3. [UI / UX Design](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#services) (Base: ₹20,000 INR)
   - Human-centered interfaces designed in Figma.
   - Frictionless conversion funnels, interactive prototyping, and seamless checkout flows.

4. [Commercial Product Photography & Motion](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#services) (Base: ₹18,000 INR)
   - High-resolution studio lighting, macro product styling, packaging shoots, and short-form video reels.

5. [Search Engine Optimization & Core Web Vitals](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#services) (Base: ₹12,000 INR)
   - Crawler mechanics, structured JSON-LD schema integration, citation building, local Kolkata search dominance, and organic keyword acquisition.

## Featured Case Studies & Client Work

- [Walplast FIFA 2026 Campaign](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#portfolio):
  Tournament campaign planning, content strategy, and community engagement rollout delivering **1.1M+ organic views** and **30,000+ engagements** for Walplast Drychem.

- [Bisleri 31-Day Winter Hydration Plan](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#portfolio):
  31-day winter hydration content strategy featuring 31 editorial storylines, visual scripts, and conversion copywriting.

- [Zee Bangla Sonar Media Flow](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#portfolio):
  Social media coordination flow and content planning support for television properties, structuring 16-post media delivery frameworks.

- [MSP Steel B2B Support](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#portfolio):
  Multi-channel B2B social media architecture and corporate positioning for premier Indian steel manufacturer.

- [Marketing Notebook Ad Teardowns](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#portfolio):
  In-depth advertising teardowns of iconic Indian FMCG brands paired with original visual storyboards and consumer psychology frameworks.

- [Core Fit Social Creative](https://www.digitallykolkata.online/#portfolio):
  High-conversion fitness creative direction, bold typography, and visual engagement hooks.
